content: We need number of CH3 groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is the one we have in the environment (the "sample at hand"). We can get NMR spectra to infer number of methyl groups. Use proton NMR to see signals for CH3 (singlet, doublet, etc). Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbon signals (~10-30 ppm). The cheapest is proton NMR. Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
